description: [SYNTHETIC] Employee sign-in from a foreign country during approved travel; MFA approved on the registered device.
details: Confirmed against the HR travel calendar. No further activity. Closed after the travel dates ended.

description: [SYNTHETIC] Many failed logins on a service account followed by a successful login from an external IP and a group membership change.
details: Credential guessing against a service account without MFA. The account was added to a privileged group and later used to read backup data. Credentials reset and account restricted.

description: [SYNTHETIC] Weekly authenticated vulnerability scanner triggered a port-sweep alert.
details: Source matched the approved scanner and change calendar entry. Scanner address added to the IDS tuning list.

description: [SYNTHETIC] Large upload to external cloud storage from a contractor workstation.
details: Endpoint logs were unavailable and the contractor had left the project. Closed as inconclusive; policy for contractor offboarding was updated.

description: [SYNTHETIC] Impossible-travel alert caused by a commercial VPN exit node.
details: Both sign-ins were the same user and device fingerprint. VPN usage was confirmed by the user.

description: [SYNTHETIC] Password spray against the VPN gateway from a single external address.
details: Attacker address blocked at the firewall by the network team after review. No successful sign-ins were found. Two accounts later received forced password resets as a precaution.
